name: kanai-windows-tsf-candidate-ui
transport: TIP-owned private broker adapter; normalized display DTO after wire/JSON decode
mapping: The TSF host maps Mozc/rerank records into these display DTOs; this layer never parses the wire frame
encoding: UTF-16LE in the C++ DTO structs

generation.rule: request_id is nonzero; the UI drops a page with an older generation and request_id breaks ties within one generation

candidateId.rule: opaque, never persisted, never reused as a Mozc rank

commands.rule: The window never ranks, converts, commits text, or performs I/O

notImplementedHere: complete UI Automation child tree and selection events
